split: One entire source test. Within every other source sort canonical patient keys, permute with numpy default_rng(42+1009*held_index+53*source_index), indices one-based; first ceil(.2*n) validation. No labels used. Same roles for all arms. Identical original seed42 roles in all three runs. Split randomness does not vary.
feature_mask: R14 coordinates8,9 zero BEFORE fitting or relative statistics. Fixed14 slots,12active. Corrected parent feature_pr.prepare/query with FIT-only unit scales, imputation and final scaling. Complete patient channel support only; never source-level target statistics.
initialization: train_seed+1009*held_index, seeds42/43/44 fixed before new fits; original complete initializer and branch slices unchanged.

timeconv.aggregation: original all-valid-window mean per seizure then equal-seizure mean/popSD

svm.calibration: OOF decision -> LogisticRegression(C=1e6,solver=lbfgs,max_iter=1000,tol=1e-8),patient-equal weights; every subFIT refits units/imputer/scaler; final estimator FIT only
svm.weights: original patient-equal times inverse pooled FIT class frequency

selection: Original per-model threshold grids/ties. Ours NEZ<threshold via original uas_core; TimeConv/SVM EZ>=threshold via original evaluate.py. Epoch key patientMacroF1,EZF1,earlierEpoch. No FIT+VAL refit, no performance gate or hyperparameter search.
phases: Strict20 seed42 sealed reuses;40 fresh selections seed43/44. ALL60 selections freeze BEFORE any new test. ALL60 scores seal BEFORE metrics. Existing seed42 results remain historical and already viewed.

statistics.sampling: paired patients WITHIN each source, fixed source sample sizes; intervals conditional on these four sources
statistics.primary: Average each patient endpoint across3seeds, then equal80patients; never probability ensemble or bestseed
statistics.seed_sample_sd: Per-arm and per-held-source sampleSD of3 seed endpoint means

interpretation: multicenter/pediatric are source strata not proven single hospitals. Original TimeConv uses about -29..+29s windows; ours pre-reference and0..20s stages, different objectives/precision/capacity. Package comparison NOT architecture-only. Three prespecified seeds conditional on the ORIGINAL seed42 FIT/VAL roles, four source strata, historically viewed cohort NOT independent external confirmation. Seeds42/43/44 are reported in full; no winner selection. Bootstrap averages each patient metric across seeds BEFORE within-source paired draws; does not represent unseen-source variability.
privacy: Code/runtime/weights on serverD, caches in place. Publish source,hashes,anonymous aggregate statistics only. Raw/IDs/patient scores/weights/preprocessors/cache/logs/secrets stay server. No extraction/research skills.
